defects.description: No layout detections available. Docling layout extraction was planned (5 batches) but files are not present in the metadata registry. Layout confidence set to 0.85 but layout_detections array is empty.
defects.impact: Content flags (has_table, has_figure, has_formula) cannot be derived from layout. Prescreening fails layout_detections check for 100% of samples.
defects.remediation: Run Docling layout extraction on nepali-handwritten images and re-integrate.

defects.remediation: Run Docling OCR extraction and integrate text content fields.

defects.description: v1 metadata had capture_method='scanner_flatbed' (from dataset_config defaults). Corrected to 'camera_smartphone' based on dataset documentation and image characteristics (variable lighting, perspective distortion).
defects.impact: Capture method was incorrect in v1. Resolved in v2 integration.

defects.remediation: VLM inspection Phase 5 Track A will verify these 344 samples.
